title: MoS2/NiS Composite Enhances Optical Hydrogen Sensing
summary: Researchers demonstrated a MoS2/NiS composite thin film sensor that achieves a 3.5-fold increase in hydrogen sensitivity.

title: Honeywell Launches AI-Enabled Fire Safety Solutions
summary: New AI detectors and carbon monoxide monitoring aim to reduce false alarms and improve emergency response.

title: KTM Introduces 330-HP Audi-Powered Buggy
summary: The KTM X-Bow Arrow luxury side-by-side buggy brings 330 horsepower to the American off-road market.

title: Skyways Unveils 1,300-Mile Cargo Drone
summary: Texas startup Skyways announced its new Skyreach cargo drone can travel over 1,300 miles at a fraction of a helicopter's cost.

title: Harwin Launches XPi Cable Design and Assembly
summary: Harwin has launched the XPi unit to provide custom cable integration services for harsh environments and safety-critical applications.

title: Siemens to Acquire Lauterbach
summary: Siemens is acquiring Lauterbach, a specialist in debug and trace tools for embedded software and SoC architectures.

title: Electric Comb for Hair Regrowth
summary: Researchers in China developed an electric comb that uses electrical pulses and genetic treatments to encourage hair regrowth among remaining follicles.

title: Study Reveals Mosquito Odor Preferences
summary: A new study shows that different mosquito species are attracted to distinct combinations of skin odors, chemicals, and bacteria.

title: Cooling Media Effects on SUP9 Steel
summary: A study investigated how different cooling media during heat treatment affect the microstructure, microhardness, and tensile properties of SUP9 spring steel.

title: SpaceX Moves Starship Booster to Pad
summary: SpaceX moved its Starship Super Heavy booster to the launch pad to prepare for an upcoming test flight.

title: Temporal Shortcuts in Robot Memory Policies
summary: Researchers showed that memory-augmented VLA policies indexing time steps can fail by treating pauses as work, and suggest event-based indexing as a fix.

title: TanCRAFT System Prevents Assembly Errors
summary: TanCRAFT is a real-time predictive assistance system that tracks scenes and provides anticipatory feedback to significantly reduce human errors in assembly tasks.

title: Dynamic Creatures Partners With Sixth Wall to Build Hasbro Robots
summary: Dynamic Creatures and Sixth Wall Studio are combining character authoring and mobile robots to bring Hasbro characters to life.

title: UGG Unified Generative Geometry Model
summary: Researchers introduced UGG, a unified framework that jointly models RGB video and geometric representations for 4D scene understanding and generation.

title: Cascading Contingency Analysis for Power Systems
summary: This paper presents a stochastic hybrid systems framework for analyzing cascading contingencies and assessing risk in modern power systems.

title: VLA Model Solves 100 Household Tasks
summary: Researchers describe a vision-language-action model solution ranking 9th in the 2026 BEHAVIOR Challenge across 100 household tasks.

title: Capacitive Bridge Transformer Eliminates Magnetic Components
summary: A new dual active bridge architecture uses an AC capacitive bridge to replace magnetic components and reduce frequency scaling barriers.

title: SIGMO Motion Planner for Autonomous Vehicles
summary: SIGMO is a sigmoid-gated motion planner that uses polynomial sigmoid functions to estimate yield scores for multi-agent navigation.

title: Sparse Gaussian-Process Critics in Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Replacing tree-ensemble critics and adversarial autoencoders with sparse Gaussian-process critics improves hybrid offline reinforcement learning.

title: Gaussian Process-Augmented MPCC for Autonomous Underwater Vehicles
summary: A nonlinear model predictive control method uses Gaussian process regression to compensate for dynamics inaccuracies in holonomic AUVs.

title: Integrated Framework for Analyzing Automated Storage Systems
summary: Combining statistical model checking with process mining quantifies performance and uncovers behavioral patterns in warehouse storage systems.

title: Geometry-Pointer-Flow Policy for Deformable Linear Objects
summary: A geometry-grounded policy separates grasp-location selection from motion generation to improve manipulation shape control of deformable linear objects.

title: Designed Training Data for Robust Channel Estimation
summary: Design criteria for synthetic training data allow offline-trained neural networks to estimate wireless channels robustly under high Doppler shifts.

title: Physics-Constrained Autoencoder for Turbofan Health Index
summary: An autoencoder embedding physical equations in its decoder architecture tracks degradation and interprets health indices in turbofan engines.

title: Chain of Physics Framework for Fault Diagnosis
summary: A large language model reasoning framework using a constrained knowledge graph improves fault diagnosis accuracy across complex industrial assets.

title: Probabilistic Reachability for Linear Systems with Noise
summary: Researchers developed sub-Gaussian and sub-exponential approaches to construct probabilistic reachable sets for linear systems under uncertainty.

title: Elastic-WAM Improves Robot Control Efficiency
summary: Elastic-WAM adaptively allocates world refinement computation across time and space to reduce inference overhead in robot control.

title: CFAR Detectors for mmWave Radio SLAM
summary: New constant false alarm rate detectors for angular power maps improve positioning accuracy and reduce complexity in mmWave radio SLAM.

title: Information-Theoretic Threshold Design for Event Encoding
summary: A data-driven criterion using a dimensionless information retention ratio is introduced for selecting sparse event-encoding thresholds.

title: Continual Learning for Personalized Human-Agent Negotiation
summary: Integrating a continual learning model for facial expression recognition into negotiation agents improves individual utility and concession rates.
